_README: SOURCE: RayStation machine model (Scanning data / Snouts tabs) and the
beam meterset calibration energy table. The gantry and fixed-beam rooms
are BEAM MATCHED, so all beam parameters live in 'defaults' and apply to
both; only mechanical limits (gantry angle, snout) differ per room.
VALUE SEMANTICS -- three states, and the difference matters:
null        not yet determined. Blocks clearance (fail-closed).
"unlimited" an explicit decision that this machine imposes no such
limit. Counts as configured; the rule is not enforced.
a number    enforced against every planned spot/layer/setting.
Never replace a null with a guessed number to unblock a plan. If no limit
exists, say so with "unlimited" -- that records the decision and is
auditable; an invented number is neither.

defaults._source: RayStation Scanning data tab: min spot meterset 0.0200 MU/fx, max spot meterset 1.5000 MU/fx, min energy layer meterset 0.2000 MU/fx. Snout SN25: field limit x -12.50 to 12.50 cm, y -12.50 to 12.50 cm. Energy table: 69.24 to 226.08 MeV. Rooms are beam matched, so these apply to both.
defaults._modulation_note: Spots per layer and energy layers per field vary widely with target size, depth and modulation -- they are plan properties, not machine caps. Recorded as "unlimited" to state that decision explicitly rather than inventing a ceiling. Observed range across 21 stored plans: up to 1797 spots/layer and 29 layers/field. If the control system does impose a hard cap, replace with that number.
defaults._range_shifter_note: RayStation snout-mounted objects: RS40 (3.47 cm PMMA), RS60 (5.17 cm), RS80 (6.91 cm), all patient side, 29.00 x 27.00 cm lateral. Only RS60 appears in the 21 stored plans, but all three are commissioned and permitted.
defaults._air_gap_note: CONFIRM THIS ONE. No independent air-gap limit appears in the machine model: SN25 lists tray distance 0.00 with range shifters mounted patient side, so the achievable air gap is already bounded by the snout position span (120-755 mm), which IS enforced above. Recorded as "unlimited" on that reasoning. If commissioning specifies a separate minimum or maximum air gap -- for spot-size degradation at large gaps, say -- replace these with the numbers.

ProNova SC360 GR._comment: Gantry rooms (TR1_Franklin_GR1, TR2_MusicCity_GR2). Beam matched to FB, so beam parameters come from defaults. The plan DICOM does not distinguish GR1 from GR2; since the rooms are beam matched this is not a problem for the beam envelope, but if their MECHANICAL limits ever differ these values must be the intersection.
ProNova SC360 GR._gantry_note: Observed angles span 1-359 deg with no clustering, consistent with continuous rotation. Replace with an explicit list if the machine permits only discrete settings.
ProNova SC360 GR._snout_note: Snout SN25 is type 'Continuous' with position span 12.00-75.50 cm. This also resolves the 755 mm snout position seen in GR plans: it is the fully retracted end of a legitimate continuous range, not a mislabelled fixed-beam plan.

ProNova SC360 FB._comment: Fixed-beam room. Beam matched to GR, so beam parameters come from defaults.
ProNova SC360 FB._fixed_geometry_note: Gantry 90 deg and snout 755 mm are structural facts of a fixed-beam room, and every one of the 12 surveyed FB beams uses exactly these. Confirm against commissioning before relying on them.

tolerance._comment: Numeric slack when comparing against limits, to absorb float-representation noise in DICOM values.
